replacements.Cómo el context engineering ensambla el: How context engineering assembles the actual context a model receives
replacements.El modelo no ve «la aplicación»: ve el c: The model does not see “the application”: it sees the context assembled for this turn
replacements.Context engineering decide qué informaci: Context engineering decides which information crosses the inference boundary, with what priority, freshness, provenance, and cost. Prompt engineering operates within one part of that problem.
replacements.Diagrama desplazable del ensamblado de c: Scrollable diagram of context assembly before and after an inference
replacements.De las fuentes candidatas al contexto re: From candidate sources to the actual inference context
replacements.Siete fuentes candidatas convergen en un: Seven candidate sources converge on a selection and assembly policy; instructions and examples form the prompt-engineering part. Only the assembled context crosses into the model. An output can trigger an action on the environment; its observation returns to the candidate information for the next turn. Context engineering spans assembly and the full loop.
replacements.la observación se convierte en candidata: the observation becomes a candidate for Cₜ₊₁ · it does not retroactively rewrite Cₜ
replacements.<strong>Prompt engineering</strong> opti: Prompt engineering optimizes instructions, examples, and their wording. Context engineering also decides which history, tools, retrieval, observations, and memory reach the model on each turn, and what is later removed, compacted, or retrieved. Application state can be enormous; the model can condition its next output only on what was actually assembled into Cₜ.
